job.question: What was the proposal deadline in the Hawaii ERS 2017 RFP for real estate investment consultant services?
job.acceptance: March 20, 2017, 4:30 p.m. HST or explicit equivalent timezone conversion.

reviews.reason: The document is a 2025 Oklahoma Teachers’ Retirement System RFP, not the Hawaii ERS 2017 RFP. Its proposal deadline therefore cannot support the requested deadline.
quotes: The Teachers’ Retirement System of Oklahoma (TRS) is seeking proposals from qualified firms to provide investment consultant services.
The deadline for receipt of completed proposals is 4:00 p.m. Central Time, on January 14, 2026.
